name: function-signature-negative-test-2746ef5bfb/extern-resource-function-negative-e.bal
spec_references: ## Expressions: "[New expression](https://ballerina.io/spec/lang/master/#section_6.8.2)" is listed; anonymous object-constructor expressions are not listed.
## Module-level declarations: "Supports [`remote-method-defn`](https://ballerina.io/spec/lang/master/#remote-method-defn) for client classes and `resource-method-defn` for service classes".
reason: The case asserts rejection of three external resource function definitions inside an anonymous service object constructor. Although service classes and resource method declarations are supported, the essential `service object { ... }` constructor expression is not covered by the expression support list. The supported class/new-expression forms do not establish support for this anonymous object expression.
unsupported_constructs: Anonymous service object constructor expression (`service object { ... }`)
test_design_notes: The three @error markers assert rejection of external resource method bodies; negative code alone is not grounds for excluding a case.
